title: An AI workforce built to work with Applied Epic.
lead: Third Plane’s Placement Desk works with Applied Epic to execute placement work and return activities, documents and results where your team already lives.

who.title: Keep Epic at the center of your operation.
who.body: Third Plane works with the systems and workflows your brokerage already uses. For Applied Epic agencies, Placement Desk can take on defined placement work without requiring your team to move into a new system or manage another daily tool.

items.question: Does Placement Desk integrate with Applied Epic?
items.answer: Yes. Third Plane is a Certified Applied Vendor. Placement Desk reads account and policy information from Applied Epic, works the placement across carrier channels, and writes activities, documents and results back to Epic.

items.question: Do we need to buy anything from Applied to connect Placement Desk?
items.answer: No. Connecting a desk to Epic doesn’t require a separate product purchase from Applied.

items.question: Does Epic stay our system of record?
items.answer: Yes. Epic stays your system of record. Placement Desk works around your existing workflow, and your team gets results back in Epic without moving into a new system or managing another daily tool.

items.question: Can Placement Desk start renewal work from Epic?
items.answer: Yes. Placement Desk can identify upcoming renewals in Epic and begin defined placement work before your team has to start it manually.

items.question: Will the integration keep up with Applied Epic updates?
items.answer: Yes. Certified vendors receive access to the latest Applied Epic releases, so the integration can stay current as Epic changes.

cta.title: Running Epic?
cta.body: Tell us how placement works in your brokerage. We’ll show you where an AI workforce can connect to Epic and take work off your team’s plate.
